topPRs.title: optimism-portal: Specify deleteProvenWithdrawal
topPRs.author: ajsutton
topPRs.body:
Specifies `OptimismPortal.deleteProvenWithdrawal`, added by
[ethereum-optimism/optimism#22669](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22669).

A withdrawal proved against a game that later resolved `CHALLENGER_WINS`, or that was blacklisted,
stays in `provenWithdrawals` forever. The record can never finalize, but nothing can clear it. The
new function lets anyone delete such a record.

The spec adds a `Deleted Withdrawal Proof` definition and a `deleteProvenWithdrawal` function
section. Both conditions for deletion are permanent, so the function needs no access control.
Deletion keeps the finalization record and the proof submitter list, so replay protection still
holds. A withdrawal proved against a retired game, or against a game that is not a respected game,
can also never finalize, but the function does not allow deletion of those records. The spec states
this limit.

The contract change is a draft. Please review the deletion conditions and the pause behaviour.
